claim: SQS delay queues and message timers allow scheduling of message delivery up to 15 minutes in the future. For more flexible scheduling, EventBridge Scheduler, which can schedule one-time or recurring API actions without time limitations, is the recommended solution for advanced message scheduling use cases.
question: What does AWS recommend when SQS delay queues and message timers (up to 15 minutes) are not enough for scheduling?

values.display: EventBridge Scheduler is the recommended solution
up to 15 minutes in the future

evidence.quote: While Amazon SQS delay queues and message timers allow scheduling of message delivery up to 15 minutes in the future, you may require more flexible scheduling capabilities. In such cases, consider using EventBridge Scheduler, which enables you to schedule billions of one-time or recurring API actions without time limitations. EventBridge Scheduler is the recommended solution for advanced message scheduling use cases.
